title: GlowSense
description: This mod provides real-time visual cues for combat, tools, and survival, highlighting the best weapon, tool, or food based on the situation to make gameplay more intuitive and responsive.
body:
# ✨ GlowSense 
### *Smart Hotbar Highlighting for Minecraft 1.21.8*

![GlowSense Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88a8df0f3c453fd3c7dc5469bf8bd7c568dcbb9d.png)

**GlowSense** ek lightweight Fabric mod hai jo aapke gameplay context ko samajhta hai aur hotbar par sahi tool ya item ko **"glow"** effect ke saath suggest karta hai. Chahe aap PvP kar rahe ho, mining, ya height se gir rahe ho—GlowSense aapko batayega ki hath mein kya hona chahiye.

---

## 🚀 Features

* **🆘 Critical Health Alert:** Jab health **3 hearts (6.0 HP)** se kam ho, toh food items ko **Yellow Glow** ke saath highlight karta hai.
* **🛡️ Auto-MLG & Mace Strike:** Girte waqt height ke hisaab se **Water Bucket, Wind Charge, Cobweb** ya **Mace** suggest karta hai.
* **⚔️ Combat Context:** Agar paas mein koi dushman (**Hostile Entity**) hai, toh automatically **Sword** highlight karta hai.
* **⚒️ Smart Tool Switcher:** Wood block dekhne par **Axe** aur Stone/Ore dekhne par **Pickaxe** ka suggestion deta hai.
* **💎 Totem Reminder:** Agar offhand khali hai aur inventory mein **Totem** hai, toh use turant highlight karta hai.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (Glow Intensities)

Mod mein teen tarah ki rendering settings hain jo bina kisi shader lag ke kaam karti hain:

| Mode | Description | Visual Style |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **MINIMAL** | Simple 1px border + soft tint | Clean & Subtle |
| **MEDIUM** | 2px Halo effect + solid border | Balanced |
| **DEEP** | 3-Layer diffuse multi-glow | **High Visibility** |

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. **Fabric Loader** install karein (Minecraft 1.21.8 ke liye).
2. `GlowSense-1.0.jar` ko apne `.minecraft/mods` folder mein dalein.
3. Game start karein aur smart highlighting ka maza lein!

---

## 💻 Tech Stack

* **Language:** Java
* **Platform:** Fabric API (Loom 1.11.8)
* **Version:** 1.21.8 (Compatible with 1.21.x)
* **Rendering:** Custom `DrawContext` overlays (Zero shader overhead).

Development: Manually wih help of AI-assisted development tools, then manually edited, tested, and balanced by me
---
